Done — all 904 tests pass against the local source.

**`src/jinja2/utils.py`** — the bare-email branch of `urlize` now skips words starting with `@`. The `_email_re` pattern (`^\S+@\w[\w.-]*\.\w+$`) matches `@user@example.com` because `\S+` happily swallows the leading `@user`, so fediverse-style handles were being turned into `<a href="mailto:@user@example.com">`:

```python
        elif (
            "@" in middle
            and not middle.startswith("www.")
            # ignore values like `@a@b`
            and not middle.startswith("@")
            and ":" not in middle
            and _email_re.match(middle)
        ):
```

The guard sits in the condition rather than in `_email_re` so the `mailto:` branch above is untouched — an explicit `mailto:@a@b.com` still behaves as before.

**`tests/test_filters.py`** — added a case to `test_urlize` asserting `"foo @user@example.com bar"` passes through unlinked.

**`CHANGES.rst`** — entry under 3.1.5. I referenced `:issue:`2131`` from recall of the upstream issue number; worth a glance if you want it exact.
